WebMaxy WhatsApp Commerce Features

Improve Sales using WhatsApp Catalogs and built-in Payment Options
WebMaxy helps you create an engaging product catalog, displaying your entire range of products or services.
In this you can add rich media like product photos, product description with price details.
The exciting and highly engaging look of your product catalog encourages customers to complete their purchase journey.

Learn more

Send Personalized WhatsApp Campaigns to Improve Sales
Personalized WhatsApp message improves Sales and encourage buyers who are still having any dilemma regarding any decision on their purchase.

Learn more



Provide Better Customer Support on WhatsApp with Agent Dashboard
Assign multiple agents to respond to multiple queries. The WebMaxy platform allows for distributing queries based on agents' expertise, ensuring prompt response times and good customer service.

Learn more

Enhance Customer Engagement with WhatsApp Chatbots and Automated Workflows
WebMaxy provides an automated workflow feature, that will automate various complex and repetitive tasks. This saves a great amount of time and efforts.

Learn more
